name: DUE_DILIGENCE_NO_DOSSIER_STARVATION_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: DUE_DILIGENCE_NO_DOSSIER_STARVATION_20261107 — LQ-20261107-142. The lane took the top 5
pending material_changes by magnitude every run. Measured 2026-11-07 on the live database: 1,426
eligible pending changes, the top five (XRPN, SNYR, MB, BF-B, ALIT) all had NOTHING linked, so
dossier() returned empty, the row was skipped, questioned_at stayed NULL, and the next run fetched
the same five. The highest-ranked change WITH evidence was rank 6 — permanently unreachable — and
the lane had written no question since the cutover while every run's receipt read ok /
nothing_due (the log holds the identical block repeatedly).
The run now scans a bounded window past the curated cap (DDQ_SCAN_MULTIPLIER / DDQ_SCAN_MAX),
orders it with one set-based evidence query (evidence_subjects), and curates the changes dossier()
can actually reason about. Ordering only: dossier() remains the authority, so a window the
prefilter calls unlinked is still attempted. A run that takes changes and can reason about none of
them is ok=false / no_dossier_evidence (no ok_at advance), never nothing_due; a genuinely empty
Hermetic: module executed from source, DB/DDL/curation/researcher stubbed, state root in tmp_path.
